customInstructions.title: Strategy Templates
customInstructions.description: Manage Codex global working preferences through strategy templates in ~/.codex/AGENTS.md without touching project-level AGENTS rules.
customInstructions.templatesDescription: Built-in templates are available now and admin-managed templates can be attached later.
customInstructions.currentDescription: Only the AI Strategist managed block is shown here. Other handwritten global rules are preserved.
customInstructions.editorDescription: Edit on top of a template, then apply only to the AI Strategist managed block in the global AGENTS file.
customInstructions.editorPlaceholder: Edit the content that will be written into the managed global strategy-template block
customInstructions.historyDescription: Recent local apply records are kept here so you can roll back quickly.
customInstructions.globalScopeHint: Only manages the AI Strategist block inside global ~/.codex/AGENTS.md
customInstructions.noManagedContent: There is no AI Strategist managed block yet.
customInstructions.clearedManagedContent: This action will clear the AI Strategist managed block.
customInstructions.clearConfirmDescription: This only removes the AI Strategist managed block from ~/.codex/AGENTS.md and preserves any other global rules you wrote yourself.
customInstructions.templatesLoadFailed: Failed to load remote templates. Falling back to built-in templates.
customInstructions.loadFailedDesc: Try again later, or check your network and refresh the page.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Diagnose system status, clean redundant data, rebuild registry, and recover local runtime issues.
maintenance.diagnoseDesc: Detect OS, architecture, version and registered account count to verify runtime environment.
maintenance.cleanDesc: Remove redundant auth backups, registry backups and stale snapshot entries to free disk space.
maintenance.cleanupBackupsDesc: Only removes old tool-generated desktop_history_repair_backups folders; keeps the latest 10 by default.
maintenance.rebuildDesc: Scan local snapshot files to regenerate registry, fixing corruption or data inconsistency.
maintenance.restartCodexDesc: Terminate and restart the local Codex process to apply config changes or recover from errors.
maintenance.restartConfirmDesc: This will terminate the current Codex process and restart it. Any ongoing operations may be interrupted.
maintenance.cleanResult: Removed: {{authBackups}} auth backups, {{registryBackups}} registry backups, {{staleEntries}} stale entries
maintenance.cleanupBackupsResult: Repair backup cleanup complete: removed {{removed}}, kept {{kept}}, errors {{errors}}
maintenance.selfCheckDesc: Entry skeleton for initialize/repair flow. Use it to verify managed runtime prerequisites before the first launch.

update.title: Update Available
update.installBlocked: AI Strategist cannot install updates from the current location. Reopen it from the real installed app path and try again.
update.installBlockedReadOnlyLocation: AI Strategist is currently running from a read-only location, so self-update cannot replace the app bundle. Move AI Strategist to Applications or a real local folder, reopen it from that path, then try again.
update.installBlockedAppTranslocation: AI Strategist is currently running from macOS App Translocation in a read-only mount, so self-update cannot write the app bundle. Move AI Strategist to Applications or a real local folder, reopen it from that path, then try again.
update.installPromptDesc: AI Strategist is currently running from a temporary macOS read-only location, so future updates will fail. Move AI Strategist into Applications, then reopen it from the real installed app path.
